item: The shard test no longer depends on pytest's wording when nothing ran (pytest 9)
summary: test_a_file_named_on_the_command_line_escapes_collect_ignore_and_a_plan_does_not asserted the words 'no tests ran' beside exit code 5. pytest 9 prints 'N warning(s) in ...' instead of those words whenever anything warns, so the test went red on pytest 9.2.0 in an environment that warns, with no code change; nothing pins pytest (pyproject says >=8.2). The assertion now pins exit code 5 and that nothing passed or failed, which is what the shard rule needs. Test-only; no pin added, because a pin would only hide the next wording change.
